resources.string:
Standard root can read, modify and delete app and media files, and read any other app's private data. It cannot modify protected OS configuration files, take on another app's identity, load kernel modules, write to raw partitions, remount system partitions, or change SELinux enforcement.

Unrestricted root removes those limits and disables SELinux enforcement for this app. Only use it if an app fails under Standard.

Only grant root to apps you fully trust.
